items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Baron, yeah. Timmy Rosencrantz and the little guy from Vietnam or whatever his -- Harry Lim, and this whole crowd was gathered and George Simon's apartment.

ctx.x: And one day, he was in the Village, and Bob Thiele, he runs into Bob Thiele, it was a Sunday. And Bob says to him, hey, do you know where I can get a job? It's Sunday. He says, no, what do you need a job for? The saloons aren't open. He says, well, there's this party going on, Leonard Feather and the Count whatever his name, from Sweden or Norway or something, -- I think they called him --

Baron, yeah. Timmy Rosencrantz and the little guy from Vietnam or whatever his -- Harry Lim, and this whole crowd was gathered and George Simon's apartment. This, by the way, I have a feeling, is why I never got the Jazz Record published through the firm that George Simon is connected with, because I did show him the manuscript and I got a no.
